# KERNAL — The core of every coder

> A free, offline-first developer learning platform by Dhurta.Org

KERNAL is a comprehensive web-based platform for learning programming and web development. All content is free, requires no account, and works offline after the first load. Lessons include interactive code playgrounds, quizzes, real-world examples, and structured learning paths.

## About

- URL: https://kernal.dhurta.org
- Publisher: Dhurta.Org
- License: Free to use, all rights reserved
- Content language: English
- Last updated: 2026-11-12

## Available Courses (24 tracks, 360 lessons)

### Web Foundations
- Web Fundamentals (15 lessons): https://kernal.dhurta.org/learn/fundamentals
- HTML — Structure and Semantics (15 lessons): https://kernal.dhurta.org/learn/html
- CSS — Styling and Layout (15 lessons): https://kernal.dhurta.org/learn/css

### Programming Languages
- JavaScript — Logic, DOM, Async, APIs (15 lessons): https://kernal.dhurta.org/learn/javascript
- TypeScript — Type-safe JavaScript (15 lessons): https://kernal.dhurta.org/learn/typescript
- Python — General programming, automation, data (15 lessons): https://kernal.dhurta.org/learn/python

### Tools and Collaboration
- Git & GitHub — Version control (15 lessons): https://kernal.dhurta.org/learn/git
- SQL — Queries, joins, data modeling (15 lessons): https://kernal.dhurta.org/learn/sql

### Frontend Frameworks
- React — Component-based UI library (15 lessons): https://kernal.dhurta.org/learn/react

### Backend and APIs
- Node.js — JavaScript on the server (15 lessons): https://kernal.dhurta.org/learn/nodejs
- Web APIs — REST, fetch, auth, HTTP patterns (15 lessons): https://kernal.dhurta.org/learn/apis

### Databases
- PostgreSQL — Advanced SQL, transactions (15 lessons): https://kernal.dhurta.org/learn/postgresql
- MongoDB — Document databases, aggregation (15 lessons): https://kernal.dhurta.org/learn/mongodb
- Redis — Caching, pub/sub, data structures (15 lessons): https://kernal.dhurta.org/learn/redis

### DevOps and Infrastructure
- Linux & Shell — Command line, scripting (15 lessons): https://kernal.dhurta.org/learn/linux
- Docker — Containers, Compose, production (15 lessons): https://kernal.dhurta.org/learn/docker
- CI/CD & DevOps — GitHub Actions, pipelines (15 lessons): https://kernal.dhurta.org/learn/cicd
- Deployment & Hosting — Vercel, Railway, VPS (15 lessons): https://kernal.dhurta.org/learn/deployment
- AWS Essentials — S3, EC2, Lambda, VPC (15 lessons): https://kernal.dhurta.org/learn/aws

### AI and Machine Learning
- Machine Learning — scikit-learn, models, MLOps (15 lessons): https://kernal.dhurta.org/learn/ml
- LLMs & Prompt Engineering — APIs, RAG, agents (15 lessons): https://kernal.dhurta.org/learn/llms

### Security
- Web Security — OWASP, XSS, CSRF, SQL injection (15 lessons): https://kernal.dhurta.org/learn/websecurity
- Cryptography — Hashing, TLS, keys, post-quantum (15 lessons): https://kernal.dhurta.org/learn/cryptography

### Hardware
- Embedded & IoT — Arduino, Raspberry Pi, protocols (15 lessons): https://kernal.dhurta.org/learn/embedded

## Career Learning Paths

- Frontend Developer: Web Fundamentals → HTML → CSS → JavaScript → TypeScript → React → Git
- Backend Developer: Python → SQL → Node.js → Web APIs → PostgreSQL → Git → Docker
- Full-Stack Engineer: HTML → CSS → JavaScript → TypeScript → React → Node.js → SQL → APIs → Docker → Git
- Data Scientist / ML: Python → SQL → Machine Learning → LLMs
- DevOps / Cloud Engineer: Linux → Git → Docker → CI/CD → AWS → Deployment
- Security Engineer: Web Fundamentals → JavaScript → Web Security → Cryptography
- Embedded / IoT: Python → Linux → Embedded
